text:
mira: Quick poll — offsite tonight: what's your go-to overnight carry-on power plan? power bank, outlet-hunt, battery phone case, or 'ask lobby' roulette? 💤🔌
sam: Power bank 20k mAh. always. bring 2 cables.
diego: Hotel outlets are the villain. pack a short extension/3-port cube.
olivia: Battery case for phone + 1 USB-C PD bank. also a multi-country adapter.
jordan: honestly, I just sleep on USB-C power station at lounge. :sweat_smile: 
rachel: Tip — plug lamp base, sometimes outlets are switched. test before bed.
mira: @sam what's your bank brand? TSA-friendly?
sam: Anker PowerCore 20100. TSA ok. charges laptop if PD.
diego: mini checklist:
```
- 65W USB-C PD power bank
- 1x short USB-C cable
- 1x USB-A lightning
- small multi-adapter
- cube extension
```
olivia: +pack a 0.2m USB-C short cable. less tangles.
mira: Anyone tried a Mophie battery case? worth the bulky?
jordan: Mophie feels clunky. I'd rather a real PD brick.
rachel: For long layovers, I use hotel gym power sockets (weird but true).
offsite-bot: Reminder: shuttle to airport at 5:30am Tomorrow. :bus: 
mira: Thanks all — grabbing a cube and a 65W bank rn. :thumbsup: 
sam: :raised_hands: safe travels!
diego: see y'all at gate A12, coffee before security?
olivia: coffee yes. who brings pastries?
mira: i'll grab pastries if anyone grabs milk alternatives.
jordan: i'll do oat milk. fiesta.
